title: Tyson and the Squeak-Thump Secret
description: He broke the forbidden squeaky duck and hid it under the couch. But something keeps going SQUEAK-THUMP...
subtitle: A comic mystery about a broken squeaky duck, a guilty conscience, and a very loud tummy. Inspired by “The Tell-Tale Heart,” retold as a silly comic.

discussionHtml:
💭 Bedtime Chat

Have you ever felt guilty about a little accident — and did telling the truth make it feel smaller?

🛋️ Guilt Makes Sounds Louder Nobody else heard the SQUEAK-THUMP at all! When Tyson felt guilty, a tiny worry sounded like a giant noise. Feelings can turn up the volume.
💛 Confessing Feels Like Relief The scariest part was hiding it. Once Tyson confessed, Mom just laughed, Dad fixed the duck, and the whole family had a snack. Telling the truth fixed everything.

artDirection.style: Dav Pilkey Dog Man graphic-novel comic style: thick wobbly hand-drawn black felt-tip ink outlines, flat gouache and crayon color fills, off-white paper texture. Each scene is one full comic page with dynamic layouts (grids, 3-panel pages, a widescreen split, a full-page splash, and a two-frame Flip-O-Rama heartbeat). Wardrobe lock: only Tyson wears the blue-and-white checkered shirt; Shane solid green tee; Dad brown sweater; Mom purple top. The squeaky duck is big, bright yellow, orange beak, tiny red bow tie.
